insertText.text: Water layer for Gulf, Andaman, river
Grab already owns Thailand's in-app demand. Water is the only surface no one owns yet.
THAILAND
Two coasts and a river megacity — one foiling network
Grab Thailand owns the demand; Navier brings the foiling fleet proven in the Maldives.
Koh Samui & the Gulf — flagship beachhead
Samui ↔ Phangan ↔ Tao triangle on sealed Bucket-C geometry.

▸  Bangrak → Thong Sala (Phangan)
      ~10 nm · flagship cascade corridor
▸  Samui → Koh Tao
      ~35 nm · dive-school triangle leg
▸  Lipa Noi → Donsak (mainland)
      ~15 nm · airport-to-island gateway
▸  Nathon → Ang Thong marine park
      ~12 nm · day-trip premium hop
Phuket & the Andaman
Resort flows, Phi Phi hops, and Krabi mesh on pier-exact routes.

▸  Phuket → Phi Phi (Tonsai)
      ~25 nm · marquee Andaman hop
▸  Royal Phuket Marina → Phang Nga
      ~20 nm · limestone-bay run
▸  Phuket → Krabi (Ao Nang)
      ~40 nm · resort mesh leg
▸  Phuket → Railay
      ~25 nm · cliff-beach premium run
Bangkok — Chao Phraya & gulf gateway
River spine sealed; Pattaya, Koh Larn and Koh Chang connected cities live.

▸  Sathorn → Phra Arthit
      ~3 nm · Chao Phraya river spine
▸  Icon Siam → Wat Arun
      ~2 nm · tourist river loop
▸  Bangkok → Pattaya
      ~60 nm · gulf gateway city
▸  Pattaya → Koh Larn
      ~5 nm · day-trip island hop
A new multi-billion-dollar vertical across Thailand
Read it bottom-up: the fare a Navier boat collects today, the market a faster product unlocks — then the whole journey Grab monetizes around every crossing.
You bring the demand. We operate the water.

▸  Grab — demand, the app, the wallet and the brand.
▸  Navier — vessels, crew, maintenance, certification and the network playbook.
▸  Together — a premium foiling water tier across the Gulf, Andaman and Chao Phraya.

1.  Working session — walk the Thailand atlas and economics.
2.  Vessel demo — a live foiling run on a pilot corridor.
3.  Pilot MOU — Samui triangle beachhead, three corridors, 12-month launch window.
Explore the Grab Thailand marine network
Open the Navier × Grab Thailand Atlas, pick the first corridor, and let's discover a new foiling water tier across two coasts and a river.
